items.title: Marco Penge shows his class to claim first PGA Tour win and secure future
items.summary: It is fair to say that Marco Penge picks his moments. Two years after he shrugged off a betting scandal to rescue his DP World Tour card on the final day of the season, he repeated the trick with incredible bravado for his first win on US soil.
